note: Real run on 2026-10-05 through the InsightfulPipe MCP on a client Google Ads account, anonymised: account and campaign names replaced, ids removed, places in search terms and keyword ideas shown as [state] and [city], search terms naming other firms or people left out. account.name: A US criminal and traffic defense law firm

inputs.pace: not given, so set from the data

data_pulled: Q3 campaign last 30 days with impression share, budgets and Google's recommended budget (9 enabled campaigns)
Q7 campaign_simulation BUDGET (4 campaigns have one)
Q8 targeted locations (9 positive location targets)
Q10 search_terms_report (2349 rows, one per term, ad group and match type; 1966 distinct non-brand terms)
Q11 generate_keyword_ideas (3 seeds from Q10, the most-targeted location; 100 ideas)
